# Yum Nest (Foods & Pure Spices)

> Authentic Kerala spices, signature crispy broast masala powder, Alfaham barbecue mix, single-estate Tellicherry black pepper, Idukki green cardamom, and 100% roasted copra coconut oil.

## Brand Overview
- **Brand Name**: Yum Nest
- **Website**: https://yumnest.in
- **Founder & Culinary Consultant**: Chef Faseeha Thanseel
- **Recognitions**: Malabar Adukkala Title Winner (2018), Business Kerala Award (2024)
- **Official Launch**: Launched by Joseph IAS at Lulu Twin Tower
- **Development**: Designed & Developed by Adhil EK and Muhammed Rashid PS
- **Headquarters**: Thoppumpady, Kochi – 682005, Ernakulam, Kerala, India
- **Contact**: yumnest2000@gmail.com | +91 70122 68934

## Core Product Offerings
- **Broast Masala Powder**: Restaurant-style crispy, crunchy broasted chicken seasoning crafted with hand-selected authentic spices. No artificial preservatives.
- **Alfaham Masala (Alfa Powder)**: Traditional Malabar and Arabian charcoal slow-grill marinade blend featuring roasted whole spices and garlic aroma.
- **100% Pure Cold-Pressed Roasted Copra Coconut Oil**: Traditional Kerala copra oil cold-pressed from roasted coconut kernels for intense aroma and culinary excellence.
- **Whole Estate Spices**: Handpicked Grade-A Tellicherry Extra Bold Black Pepper and Idukki Bold Green Cardamom.
- **Mixed Vegetable Broast Masala**: Vegetarian crunchy coating for cauliflower, paneer, and mixed garden vegetables.
- **Broast Prawns Masala**: Specialized seafood seasoning for crispy deep-fried prawns and calamari.
